notes: This contract pins the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ Attribute Relevance Advisory switch accessors and both Turn Updates On overloads plus the Turn Updates Off FederateAmbassador callback used by Umbra's bounded embedded scope-transition path. Explicit retained subscription designators are grouped into the rate-bearing callback; omitted designators use the no-rate overload. Queued callbacks re-resolve the current designator at callback entry, including regional overlap transitions. It verifies exact official signatures, exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The narrow file-selected successful-void record for Set Attribute Relevance Advisory Switch is traced separately in mom-service-reporting-requirements-contract.json; generic MOM behavior and interaction delivery remain outside this slice. Advisories Use Known Class, initial registration/discovery-time advisories, complete regional DDM, update-rate enforcement/reduction, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside the slice.
